maddeler.e:
تلتحقون (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِقُونَ (taltaḥiqūna) /tal.ta.ħi.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# تُلْتَحَقُونَ (tultaḥaqūna) /tul.ta.ħa.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
